english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a screw fastener.
This is the all-purpose everyday Hong Kong term for a threaded metal fastener, including one used with a nut.

examples.english: This screw is too short to secure the wooden board.
examples.traditional: 呢粒螺絲太短，固定唔到塊木板。
examples.jyutping: ni1 nap1 lo4 si1 taai3 dyun2 gu3 ding6 m4 dou2 faai3 muk6 baan2

examples.english: This bolt needs a nut to be secure.
examples.traditional: 呢粒螺絲要配返粒螺帽先至實。
examples.jyutping: ne1 nap1 lo4 si1 jiu3 pui3 faan1 nap1 lo4 mou2 sin1 zi3 sat6
